# An XP wisp: an octahedron of pale light 0.3 x 0.34 m (the largest size; small ones are scaled), unlit.
# Generated by make_models.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Wisp --base-color 0.5725 0.9098 0.7529 --no-slot --emission 0.5725 0.9098 0.7529
add mesh cone --name Wisp --vertices 4 --radius1 0.15 --radius2 0 --depth 0.1700 --location 0 0 0.0850
add mesh cone --name WispB --vertices 4 --radius1 0.15 --radius2 0 --depth 0.1700 --location 0 0 -0.0850 --rotation 180 0 0
apply --rotation
select Wisp WispB
active Wisp
join
material assign Wisp
export wisp.glb
